recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Any future Condition.category code or example changes should be handled through current Patient Care and terminology governance, not by restoring DSTU1 ballot wording.
issue_request: FHIR-5255 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Patient Care ballot comment asking to replace duplicated Condition.category example wording, "finding | Condition | diagnosis | concern | condition", with wording aligned to the then-current value set, "finding | complaint | diagnosis | symptom | etc."
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-5255 was found. The initial imported Condition spreadsheet already contained the proposed complaint/symptom/finding/diagnosis element wording while the ConditionCategory binding definition still carried the older duplicated list. Commit b62a71399e6c7c3092a36b37b627835e687e36d1 later removed example-list wording from both the Condition.category element definition and the ConditionCategory binding definition.
additional_context: Condition is active in source/fhir.ini. The current Condition StructureDefinition defines Condition.category neutrally as "A category assigned to the condition," binds by example to ValueSet/condition-category, and no longer contains the DSTU1 example list. The current value set composes the THO condition-category code system. Later Published Patient Care issues FHIR-10091, FHIR-10404, FHIR-10611, and FHIR-11156 reworked Condition.category around encounter-diagnosis and problem-list-item rather than the old four-code list; FHIR-8872 records that symptom-specific value set text became not applicable after that later decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing the FHIR-5255 proposed local example list would conflict with later applied decisions and would create new drift from the current value set/code system design.

related_jiras.note: Resolved the later Condition.category terminology/binding question with an example FHIR-defined value set rather than the old DSTU1 framing.
Collected ballot feedback on Condition.category codes and shares the September 2016 final resolution.
Objected to a required four-code Condition.category value set and supports not restoring complaint/symptom/finding/diagnosis as a fixed list.
Requested problem/issue concepts and was resolved into the encounter-diagnosis/problem-list-item approach.
Records that symptom category guidance was superseded when symptom was removed from the value set.
